section_title: Configure the profile the engine should read
section_intro: This surface does not show a made-up final number. It shows where cost begins to concentrate before the full ranking even runs.
capital_hint: Capital changes the balance between percentage drag and ticket cost.
frequency_hint_low: Few executions, more sensitivity to holding cost.
frequency_hint_medium: Balanced profile between execution and holding.
frequency_hint_high: Many executions, more sensitivity to spread and ticket cost.
score_note: Pre-ranking synthetic signal for the selected profile.
insight_intraday: On an intraday profile, the first risk is paying too much on each execution.
insight_multiday: In multi-day trading, holding cost stops being a marginal detail.
insight_position: On long holding profiles, swap can overturn the apparent convenience of the instrument.
read_horizon_intraday: Short holding window: the engine prioritizes execution drag.
read_horizon_multiday: Intermediate holding window: spread and swap begin to weigh together.
read_horizon_position: Extended holding window: swap becomes structural risk.
read_frequency_low: Low turnover: fewer entries, higher attention to carry.
read_frequency_medium: Medium turnover: mixed profile between ticket cost and holding drag.
read_frequency_high: High turnover: every bad spread compounds quickly.
read_capital_small: Compact capital: ticket cost can distort the profile heavily.
read_capital_mid: Mid-size capital: cost structure must be compared by instrument and broker.
read_capital_large: Large capital: percentage drag becomes even more critical.
preview_note: Qualitative indicator based on the selected profile. Full TradeScope applies broker tariffs and returns the final ranking.
